text.body: padacandrikā śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ umāputraṃ namaskṛtya yājñavalkyaṃ gurūṃstathā svarādīnāṃ prabodhāya kriyate padacaṃdrikā 1 uccairudātto vijñeyo'nudātto nīca eva ca svaraścobhayavānsvāraḥ pravāṃ svaśca nidarśanaṃ 2 svaro hrasvo'pyudāttaḥ syānnīcaḥ svarita eva ca dīrghapluto'pyevameva jñeyaṃ sarvatra vaidikaiḥ 3 aṣṭau svarān pravakṣyāmi teṣāmeva tu lakṣaṇaṃ jātyo'bhinihitaḥ kṣaipraḥ praśliṣṭaśca tathāparaḥ 4 tairovyaṃjanasaṃjñaśca tathā tairovirāmakaḥ pādavṛttastathātāthābhāvyaścāṣṭausvarāḥ smṛtāḥ 5 vyaṃjanaistu yavaubhyāṃ ca paro yaḥ svāra eva ca apūrvo nīca pūrvo vā jātyaḥ svāraḥ sa ucyate 6 dhānyaṃ manuṣyāṃ cambī ca vīryaṃ kanyā iveti ca bhāvyaṃ cokthyaṃ pathye vā pūrva nīcaḥ sva ucyate 7 edottoruccayoryatra nīcokāraḥ paro yadi pūrvarūpe'bhinihito'pyadāttasya tu bādhakaḥ 8 visargo'pyupadhā yuktaścautvamāpadyate yadā akāre ca pare caiva vedo asīti ca sthite 9 edodbhyāṃ ca parokāraḥ pūrvarūpaṃ tu niścitaṃ āpadyate teṣvarasāṃ vedosīti nidarśanaṃ 10 iuvarṇau udāttau ca yavau ca prāpnutastadā anudātte pare caiva yavābhyāṃ nīca eva ca svaritaḥ kṣaiprasaṃjñaḥ syādvājyarvan tryaṃbakaṃ tathā devye tu sūnṛtā caiva dvrannonvīṃdraśceti darśanaṃ 11 hrasvekāro'pyudāttaśca nīcekāraḥ parastathā ekībhāve tayorjāte svāraḥ praśliṣṭasaṃjñikaḥ 12 abhīndhatāṃ divī vāpi srucī vā bhīmameva ca evaṃ sarvatra vijñeyaṃ vaidikaistu vicakṣaṇaiḥ 13 udāttapūrvaḥsvarito vyaṃjanena samanvitaḥ tairovyaṃjanasaṃjñaḥ syātsvānabhyāja yathā yayā 14 ileraṃtedite caṃdre jyote mahica viśruti sarasvati tavāgne ca havye kāmye gave hariḥ 15 udāttāvagrahādyatra paraśca svarito'sti cet tairovirāmaṃ taṃ vidyāt gomatprapreti gopatau 16 svarayoraṃtare yatra vivṛttiryadi dṛśyate tasyāḥ paro yaḥ svaritaḥ pādavṛtta sa ucyate 17 dātra edhi catā asya navā' nuka'upeti ca ka ' īndevā ' asannevaṃte ' asyeti nidarśanaṃ 18 udāttādirudāttāṃto nīco'vagraha eva ca tāthābhāvyaḥ savijñeyaḥ kaṃpaṃ tatra vadeddhruvaṃ 19 tanūnapāttanūnaptre tanūnapātameva ca aṣṭau svarā ime proktāḥ prātiśākhyānusārataḥ 20 ityaṣṭau svaritāḥ svarito'pyanudāttena tvekī bhāve kṛte tadā svaritaraktabhavettatra brahmā sṛjyata darśanam 1 ekībhāvo'pyudāttena sa udātto bhaveddhruvaṃ morutvāśābhya evaiti brahmāpaścamamediha 2 udāttādanudāttaṃ ca tvakṣaraṃ svaritaṃ bhavet iṣe tvā vāyavastannaḥ svāheti ca nidarśanam 3 udāttātsvaritātpūrvaḥ svaritaśca nihanyate āghāye phalinīryāśca bhuvaḥ svariti darśanaṃ 4 svaritādanudāttasya pracitaḥ syādapi dhruvaṃ vājonaścāpranoyachavyuptakeśāya darśanam 5 udāttātsvaritātpūrvaṃ nihitapracayo na ca syānnaḥ sūnustathā yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaśceti darśanaṃ 6 nīcaśceti padānnasyāpracitastu tathaiva saḥ avagrahātparo yatra codātte svarite pare 7 pade devagaṇāḥ prājāpatyo virurucustathā tarattabhāne'bhipitve ca senānye ca nidarśanaṃ 8 yade kasmin pade jāte svāre codāttamakṣare tamekaṃ varjayitvāttu śeṣaṃ nihitamakṣaraṃ 9 vāyavastūparo brahmādhāteṃdrā pūṣaṇā hariḥ asmachabdasyācādeśā no nau me mācayuṣmadaḥ 10 ādeśā nihitāḥ syurvai tvāvovāṃ te tu niścitaṃ ucitsamasmānmaryā īmare svitsmahavācakaṃ 11 ghetyete cānudāttāḥ syurnipātā yadicettarhi viveśeti padaṃ nīcaṃ vicārārthakamasticet 12 aṃtyākṣaraṃ trimātraṃ syānnaparasya trimātratā vicārārthakamāsīdve tayoścaiva trimātratā 13 aṃtodāttaṃ tu pūrvaṃ syāt paraṃ sarvānudāttatāṃ lāṃjī3ñchāṃcī3ca praṇavaḥ sarvodāttābhavanti ca 14 aṃtyākṣaraṃ trimātraṃ syātsamyagjñeyaṃ tu vaidikaiḥ 15 bodhāmerocanākohaṃ patetvaṃ diva eva ca maṃhīya īśa īśānametāraḥ pāra ityapi 16 ebhyaḥ paro'sya śabdasya tvādyudātto bhavetsadā pātaṃdhiyeṣitāṃ pratnāṃ yajñasyodṛca eva ca 17 madhvaḥ pibatalokaśca hotaḥ pradiśyṛtastathā yajamānasyājarāso haviṣaśca pareṣu ca 18 aṃtodātto bhavatyasyānyatra sarvānudāttattā 19 nābhirasya ṣalasyeti guhāsyeti nidarśanaṃ gṛbho bhuvo'gniśabdācca yathāsarvānudāttatāṃ 20 agnipūrvaṃ ghṛteneti vadetsarvānudāttatāṃ enaścāpāpavācī ca sarvo nīcaśca jāyate 21 padapūrvamapādādāvanānārthe ca dṛśyate saṃbodhanaṃ prāpnoti taṃ dhruvaṃ sarvānudāttatāṃ 22 kadāriṣyemapūrvaṃ ca tvādyudātto bhaveddhruvaṃ mṛgavācī kṛṣṇaśabdastvādyudātto na saṃśayaḥ 23 parimāṇe ca mātrā catvādyudātto'pi dakṣiṇā niṣadya daśasadbhyaśca viśvakarmāsadastathā 24 iṃdrasya pātu caiteṣu dakṣinādyudāttatāṃ karṇaḥ svāṃgemahaḥ klībe skaṃdho vīrye'pi cādirut 25 bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ karṇau te mahasthāṃdhastha eva ca etāśabdo varṇavācī ādyudātto na saṃśayaḥ 26 rāyopoṣe tvādyudāttastverāya iti darśanaṃ antodāttaśca rāyaśca poṣeṇa bhāgamīśiṣe 27 ādyudāttastridhāśabdaḥ parayo hitabaddhayoḥ sukṛtaṃ cādyudāttaśca bhūtārthasya ca vācakaḥ 28 pāyuśabdātparo'pyaṃto viśastu jāyate astyaryamorvaśībhyāṃtodāttastvāyurbhaveddhruvaṃ 29 urvaśyāyuścāryamāyurasti āyorapi dhruvaṃ dvaṃdvassomeṃdrapūrvaśca tvaṃtodātto bhaveddhruvaṃ 30 dvirudāttāpavādo yameṣu pūṣāgnivāyuṣu yaṃtrīrāṭ śabdayoge tu rohitaśca tu kevalaḥ ādyudātto bhavennityaṃ varṇa vācī tu niścitaṃ 31 iti svara prakaraṇam atha ākhyātasvaraprakaraṇaṃ padapūrvamapādādau varttamāne yadāsti cet anānārthakamākhyāttaṃ vadetsarvānudāttatām 1 satyaṃ jinvavayaṃ syāma praṇudānastathā'bhaja gopatau syātatāviṣṇo vedo'sīti ca darśanaṃ 2 ākhyātapūrvamākhyātaṃ prakṛtyā bhavati dhruvaṃ āmaṃtritādyudāttānitprakṛtyākhyātameva ca 3 agnenayatathā hotaryajeti ca nidarśanaṃ ekātarādādyudāttādāmaṃtritapadādapi 4 prakṛtyāsyāttadākhyātaṃ kvacitsarvānudāttatāṃ āmaṃtritapadābhāve tadartho'pyavamāsate 5 prakṛtyākhyātameva syāt prajābhyastvetyṛci sthitaṃ yacchabdātparamākhyātaṃ prāpnoti prakṛtisvaraṃ 6 sa ca sarvavibhaktyaṃtaḥ pratyayāṃto'pi gṛhyate yasya yenārthasaṃbaṃdho dūrasthasyāpi tasya tat 7 arthato hyasamarthānāmānaṃtaryamakāraṇaṃ agniṃ yamāhurmanavo yathā yaṃ vāyurejati 8 yadatti ca tathā cānye yato'jāto arocathāḥ hi śabdātparamākhyātaṃ prakṛtyā syāttu cottare 9 hyajaniṣṭa tathāhisthettyuśaṃti hi pare tathā samuccaye dvayoḥ pūrvaṃ prakṛtyā syāttataḥ paraṃ 10 nihanyate dvitīyaṃ tu śarmacastho nidarśanaṃ samanasaḥ paraṃ caiva prakṛtyā tu karadbhavet 11 nedityasmānnipātācca prakṛtyākhyātamevaca samuccaye ca kāro vā draṣṭavyaṃ vā vicāraṇe 12 viniyogeha śabdastu eva śabdo'vadhāraṇe ca vā haiva padānāṃ ca yadyanuccāraṇe sati 13 teṣāṃ kathaṃ cidartho'pi yadi tatrāvagamyate tatrākhyātaṃ prakṛtyā tu vedabhāṣye tvidaṃsthitaṃ 14 maruto vaṃdate gīśca jyotiryachaṃti darśanaṃ śivāpayasvatī caiva su ṣadā ca madhumatīḥ 15 yattenādhṛṣṭamojasvān bhrājasvāñchuṣmiṇī tathā bhrājasvān bhadravācyāya vedyo medhyo yamastritaḥ 16 svasādityaśca somenetyeteṣu ca pareṣu ca dhanadāratnadhābhyāṃ catvādyudātto bhavedasiḥ 17 ekonaviṃśatiścāsirādyudātto na saṃśayaḥ viṃśaterupasargāṇāṃ uccā ekākṣaraṃ nava 18 ādyudātto daśaiteṣāmaṃtodāttastvabhītya yaṃ upasargo'nudāttaḥ syādupasarge pare vṛtti 19 saṃprayātaṃ tathā saṃpracyavadhvaṃ ca nidarśanaṃ ākhyāte ca kṛdaṃte ca udātte ca pare sthite 20 upasargo nudāttasyātsaṃbharaṃ syapivāti ca āmreḍite cottaraṃ syātsarvo nicarattu niścitaṃ 21 upopetsaṃsamiccaiva praprāyamitidarśanaṃ iti ākhyātopasargaprakaraṇaṃ cachayoḥ parayoḥ śatvaṃ visargasya tu jāyate vājaśca prasavaśceti paṃktiśchaṃdaścapyadarśanaṃ 1 tathayoḥ parayoḥ satvaṃ visargasya tu jāyate aṃtaste ca namaste ca devāstā ca nidarśanaṃ 2 śaṣaseṣu pareṣveva kakhayoḥ paphayorapi visargastu prakṛtyā syāt pakṣe'rddhaḥ kādiṣu dhruvaṃ 3 mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śanno'pyaditiḥ ṣolaśeti ca devo vaḥ savitā vaḥ svaḥ pakṣe syuḥ śaṣasāḥ kramāt 4 naḥ kalpaṃ tāṃ tathaivāpi tataḥ svanemaniścitaṃ yāḥ phalinīścayaḥ potā pakṣetvarddha visarjanaḥ 5 sa ityasya visargo'pi vyaṃjane ca pare sthite lupyate sapituścaiva sanaḥ sajāyate'pica 6 sakārāttathayoreva visargo lupyate dhruvaṃ tadviṣṇustavateṃdhastho vāyavastheti darśanaṃ 7 pīvaṃ śabdā dvisargo'pi tathopavasane pare sa ityasya visargo'pi lupyate tvoṣadhīmayoḥ 8 sya eṣayostu lopaḥ syādvyaṃjane ca pare sthite syarāthyasya vājī ca tveṣate ca nidarśanaṃ 9 kaṃṭhya pūrvavisargasya satvaṃ bhāvyuttarasya ca visargasya ca ṣatvaṃ syāt adhikārāpyataḥ paraṃ 10 ilāyā varivaścelo'pyāvirnirvasatistathā etatṣaṭ padasaṃbaṃdhī satvaṃ ṣatvamanukramāt 11 divokakutpṛthivyośca rāyaḥsahasa eva ca etayośca visargasya satvaṃ syātpoṣaputrayoḥ 12 divasputrāya sūryāya divaspṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīṃ divaspṛṣṭhandivasparjanyādapīti nidarśanaṃ 13 divaḥ pṛthivyā paryojaścāgnirmūrddhā divaḥ kakut rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃścaiva sahasasputra eva ca 14 tamasaśca visargaśca parastānna pade pare tamasasyāramasyāpi codvayattamasaspari 15 riṣaḥspṛśastu rajaso dhanaḥ pātau pare sthite pādhātorgrahaṇaṃ cātra riṣaspātu nidarśanaṃ 16 tapasaḥ pṛthivī śabde satvamapyadhvanaskurau divo vibhāti tapasaḥ pṛthivyāmadhvanaskuru 17 visargasya saṣau syātāṃ samāne ca pade sati bhūyaskaraśca cakṣaṣpā pathaspathaśca darśanaṃ 18 paruṣāttu visargaśca satvamāpadyate na ca pare paruṣi śabde ca paruṣaḥ paruṣaspari 19 pariśabde vasānasthe kaviḥ karatkṛdhiṣvapi pareṣu ca visargasya satvaṃ ṣatvaṃ tvanukramāt 20 oṃ ṣadhayasparītyeva paruṣasparuṣaspari noṃvasyasaskaraccaiva punaskṛdhi vasuṣkaviḥ 21 kṛṣeḥ satvaṃ kṛdhāveva kṛṣīskṛdhisuniścitaṃ sadodyaurnama eteṣāṃ kṛtapitṛpatheṣu ca 22 visargasya sakāraśca ṣakāraśca sadaskṛtam tathaiva dyauṣpitā caiva namaspatha iti dhruvaṃ 23 ṣaṣṭyaṃtātpatiśabde ca visargaḥ satvamāpnuyāt vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmā pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ 24 bhāvibhyaḥ sasya ṣatvaṃ syāt samāne ca pade sthite sīṣayāmasuṣā vaiva goṣṭhānaṃ parameṣṭhyapi 25 bhāvibhyaśca visargeṇa vyavadhāne'piṣo bhavet samāne ca pade caiva duḥṣvapnyaṃ suva eva hi 26 anusvārāṅgāvipūrvāt sasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate tapūm̐ṣyagne havīṃṣyā ca jñeyamanyatra vaidikaiḥ 27 sa kārasya ca ṣatvaṃ syānneḥ parasya ca sīdateḥ neḥ parasya sasādasya niṣasādaniṣīdataḥ 28 mośabdācca su śabdasya ṣatvaṃ moṣūṇa eva ca ukārādavyayātsuśca ṣatvaṃ coṣūṇa eva ca 29 abheḥ parasya ṣatvaṃ syāt suśabdasya tvabhīṣuṇaḥ pareśca siṃcateḥ ṣatvaṃ pariṣiṃcatyabherapi 30 siṃcatereva ṣatvaṃ syādabhiṣiṃcābhijāyate vyavadhāne tvakāreṇābhyaṣiṃcanyābhireva ca 31 upasargātsasya ṣatvaṃ te viṣyāmi ca viṣyatu ataḥ paraṃsasya ṣatvaṃ parayostathayoṣṭaṭhau 32 hi śabdātsasya ṣatvaṃ syāt mathayoḥ parayoḥ satoḥ thasya ṭhattvaṃ tu hiṣmāte tvāpo hiṣṭhāmayo bhuvaḥ 33 dyavi śabdātsasya ṣatvaṃ thakāre ṭho dyavi ṣṭhaca nisaḥ sasya ca ṣatvaṃ syāt parasya tasya ṭastathā 34 tatakṣau niṣṭatakṣuśca nisaścastyāyatestathā sadhiraṃśuścāditiśca mākirvaṃdārurevaca 35 eteṣāṃ tu visargasya ṣatvaṃ ṭatvaṃ parasya tu sadhiṣṭavatathāśuṣṭettvādiniṣṭvā tathaiva ca 36 mākiṣṭe vyathirādadharṣī dvaṃdāruṣṭe suniścitaṃ vāyoragnervisargasya ṣatvamekākṣare caṭaḥ 37 vāyuṣṭe'dhipatiścaiva tvagniṣṭe'dhipatistathā saparaikākṣare ṣatvaṃ visargasya parasya ṭaḥ 38 bṛhaspatiṣṭvāsumne ca patiṣṭvāsādayatvapi pāyubhirmātṛbhiścaiva varūtrīrarcibhistathā 39 eteṣāṃ tu visargasya ṣatvaṃ syāttasya ṭau bhavet vāyubhiṣṭvaṃ mātṛbhiṣṭvaṃ varūtrīṣṭvārcibhiṣṭvasu 40 pṛtanāyāḥ saheḥ sasya pṛtanā ṣātya eva ca iti visargaprakaraṇam atha satvaṣatvaniṣedha prakaraṇaṃ atisthūlaṃ susasyāśca bṛhaspati sutasya hi kratusthalāṃ jisaktho'nusaṃtanotu susaṃdṛśaṃ 1 susamiddhāyābhisatvābhisaṃviśaṃtu ca gosaniḥ musale hariṇīḥ sīsāsīsena ca divispṛśaṃ 2 sīsaṃ divispṛśā patnī saṃyājānpaśusanyapi pratisadṛṅ ca hīsīścaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsastathaiva 3 pṛthivicarṣaṇīyāsi śakunyupari vai divi ebhyaḥ parasya sasyaiva ṣatvaṃ na syāttaniścayaḥ 4 prakṛtyo parisadbhyaśca pṛthivī sadameva ca yāsi sīṣṭhā divisadaṃtveva ca carṣaṇīsahāṃ 5 tayā śakuni sādena pāṭho'nyo'śuddha eva hi tisṛbhistittiriste ca tisra ṛksāmayorapi 6 aṃtaḥ pārśvyaṃ vājapatirvāsa edidhiṣustathā aṃtaḥ parśavyenaiteṣāṃ visargasya saṣaunahi 7 vāsaḥ palpūlimekaṃ ca parivājapatiḥ kaviḥ prāptasya tu niṣedhaḥ syāt tathaivaididhiṣuḥ patiḥ 8 ahaḥ śabdo visargo'pi rephamāpadyate patau svalpodāharaṇānyatra pyuktā vigraṃthagauravāt prātiśākhye ca draṣṭavyaṃ saṃdeho yatra jāyate 9 iti satvaṣatvaniṣedhaprakaraṇam | lopāgamaprakaraṇam ucyaṃte tvita ūrdhvaṃ tu lopāgamau tathaiva ca vikāraścāthavarṇasya mūrdhanyaśca parasya ca 1 svardhūrośca visargaśca rephamāpadyate yadā sāṃsahoḥ parayoścaiva mūrddhanyaṃ tu parasya ca 2 svarṣāmappāṃ tu kāṇvasya dhūrvāhāviti jāyate mādhyaṃdinīye dhūrṣāhau tadabhiprāyakaṃ tvidaṃ 3 durityasyavisargasyāpyūkāro de pare sthite parasyaiva tu mūrddhanyaṃ dūlabhoratha eva ca 4 puro visarjanaścotvaṃ dakāre ca pare sthite parasyaiva tu mūrddhanyaṃ puroḍāśairhavīṃṣi ca 5 anasaḥ sasya ḍatvaṃ ca vāhvaśabde pare sthite anaḍvānapyanaḍvāhamanvāramāmahe tathā 6 āghāśabdāttakārasya ṭo dārvāghāṭa eva ca vanaśabdaḥ sakāreṇa patāveva vanaspatiḥ 7 vanaḥ śabdaḥ sade śabde repheṇa vyavadhīyate veṭapare ca sade śabde na syāllakṣyaṃ vanarṣadaḥ 8 ṛtāvarausakāreṇa vyavadhānaṃ patau pare yathā saṃkhyenaiva ṛtaspate varasya eva ca 9 tadbṛhato stakārasya lopaḥ syāttu kare patau vyavadhānaṃ sakāreṇa taskarośca bṛhaspatiḥ 10 pariśabdaḥ kṛte śabde ṣatve na vyavadhīyate suśabdaścaiva caṃdre ca śatve na vyavadhīyate 11 pariṣkṛtāstu pūrvasya tvubhesuścaṃdrasarpiṣaḥ dudhukṣanpadasaṃbaṃdhī dhakārodatvamāpnuyāt 12 iti lopāgamaprakaraṇam atha ṇatvaprakaraṇaṃ ṛṣarebhyaḥ samāne ca padenasya tu ṇo bhavet pitṝṇāṃ ca nṛṇā pūṣṇaḥ pūrṇaṃ ceti nidarśanaṃ 1 kavargeṇa pavargeṇa svareṇa yavahairapi etairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca vyavadhāno'pi jāyate 2 nṛmaṇāśca pavitreṇa tathā purīṣa vāhanaḥ karmaṇe varuṇābhyāṃ ca pravāhaṇaśca darśanaṃ 3 iṃdra eṇaṃ niṣaṇṇāya rakṣāṇaḥ pariṇīyate ṣuṇāsatyāṣuṇatvasvarṇāsthūriṇaśca samiṃdraṇaḥ 4 praṇa āyūṃṣyuruṣyāṇaḥ pariṇorathavāhaṇaṃ propasargāddhinomeśca ṇatvaṃ ca prahiṇomi vā 5 propasargānnudātteśca
